d6b21ce2cef8: An analogy with English: “was giving” and “gave” work the same way. Stress that the student already feels the difference; only the form of the Polish pairs is new.
e67583c02bee: «Przez pięć lat» answers «how long did it last». «W ciągu dwóch dni» means the result is ready within that time.
8600f9a5c3e1: I have already closed the month in the system.
b2ffdd0cbe93: The first example is background plus event. The second is a chain of completed steps. Ask her to build a similar chain about her own working day.
e6287b2c279a: This is the first sentence of her self-presentation. Have her give her own version with real details straight away.
02f974b477ea: The key slide for job interviews. The first two rows are confused most often: «być» takes the narzędnik (instrumental), «jako» the mianownik (nominative).
cc13ecfdc692: «Prowadzić księgi» describes a process, so we say “prowadziłam” even about a completed period. The form “poprowadzić” exists, but with a different meaning (poprowadzić spotkanie).
0cf1c27a021d: To calculate or accrue pay = naliczyć. Instead of „zarpłata” say: wynagrodzenie or pensja.
ced73ad45162: The tax office sent a letter.
8334f8c40ae1: I kept the books for five years.
5e934b257671: I filed the return on time.
106cfc3ae735: The last trap goes back to the main rule of the lesson. Ask: «And how would you say that you submitted the returns on time every month?» (Składałam deklaracje na czas)
